app: AI-Weld Settings Library / Vectis Weld Recipe Control
purpose: Create the V2 baseline search/filter view structure so users can find mild steel baseline range records without treating them as recommendations or locked recipes.

locked_context.locked_recipe_rule: Locked recipes require tested result, approval, and lock authorization.
locked_context.core_rule: Baseline range = starting reference only. Tested result = what actually happened. Locked recipe = approved production record.

empty_state_behavior.no_records_message: No baseline range reference records found for the selected filters.
empty_state_behavior.no_records_guidance: Adjust filters or add a new reference-only baseline range entry.

create_test_coupon.label: Create Test Coupon
create_test_coupon.enabled_when: baseline_range_id exists and requiresTestCoupon is true
create_test_coupon.result: Starts linked test coupon workflow in a future milestone. Does not approve, lock, or mark production-ready.

view_rules.rule: Search/filter helps users find reference records only. It does not recommend, rank, auto-select, approve, lock, or create production-ready recipes.
